description: Publish an incident to the customer status page with a public title, impact, components, audience and a first update. Only the incident's commander, its owning team, an Owner or an Admin may; the page must be on; a test or private incident is refused. A withdrawn publication can be published again. Titles and messages are what customers read: no internal names, repositories, people or other customers. Text the disclosure check stops is refused with disclosure_hits_remaining and the hits; reword it. Acts as you, with the same checks as the Console; a service account's key is refused. Requires `write` scope.

accountIds.description: Customer account ids; required with audience accounts.

audience.description: public: the public page and every customer link. accounts: only the links of accountIds.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

startedAt.description: When the public problem began, epoch milliseconds; defaults to when the incident was detected.

status.description: resolved resolves it on the page; another status after that reopens it.

title.description: One line customers read (at most 120 characters). Not the internal title or cause.

name: anyforge_publish_status_page_incident
title: Publish status page incident
